key.name: poll-interval
key.summary: Milliseconds between status checks

key.name: idle-poll-interval
key.summary: Milliseconds between status checks while nothing runs and the menu is closed

key.name: extra-config-dirs
key.summary: Extra Claude config dirs, comma separated (~/.claude and ~/.claude-* are found automatically)

key.name: notify-waiting
key.summary: Notify when a chat needs input

key.name: notify-done
key.summary: Notify when a chat finishes working

key.name: notify-done-min-seconds
key.summary: Only notify about turns that ran at least this many seconds

key.name: notify-sound
key.summary: Play a sound with the notifications

key.name: sound-volume
key.summary: Notification sound volume (percent)

key.name: sound-waiting
key.summary: Sound when a chat needs input: sound theme names (comma separated, first found) or a file

key.name: sound-done
key.summary: Sound when a chat finishes

key.name: sound-failed
key.summary: Sound when a chat fails, or a usage limit or an expired login stops it

key.name: recent-chats
key.summary: Recent chats listed per account (0 = none)

key.name: ssh-hosts
key.summary: SSH hosts (from ~/.ssh/config) shown in the popup, one per entry

key.name: remote-poll-seconds
key.summary: Seconds between status checks of SSH hosts

key.name: keep-done-hours
key.summary: Keep finished background jobs listed for this many hours (0 = hide them)

key.name: usage-refresh-minutes
key.summary: While one of an account's chats works, have Claude Code fetch its plan usage once it's this many minutes old, at most this often (0 = never; VS Code's Claude Code panel runs no status line)

key.name: show-usage-in-panel
key.summary: Show 5-hour usage next to the panel icon

key.name: show-pet
key.summary: Show Talpy, the pet, in the popup and in notifications

key.name: playful-talpy
key.summary: Playful Talpy: his tricks and props and jokes; off, he only shows what the chats do

key.name: chat-pets
key.summary: Pets for each account's chats in the list, at most (0 = only the big Talpy)

key.name: show-tokens
key.summary: Show token totals from local transcripts

key.name: new-chat-in-vscode
key.summary: New and recent chats open in VS Code
key.description: Instead of a terminal; set with the Terminal | VS Code switch at the top of the new-chat and recent-chat lists.

key.name: next-chat-shortcut
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut to the chat that needs you
key.description: Waiting chats first (the one waiting longest), then finished turns you haven't seen; pressed again soon after, the next one. With none, the menu opens or closes. Empty: no shortcut.

key.name: away-digest
key.summary: A summary when you come back
key.description: After the screen was locked: the chats that finished, failed or need you, at the top of the menu until you've seen it, and as one notification while notify-waiting or notify-done is on.

key.name: away-minutes
key.summary: Only after being away at least this many minutes

key.name: recap-rules
key.summary: Suggest rules for the permission prompts you answered
key.description: The Permissions tab offers rules that would have let those prompts go without asking, each with an Allow… button. Off, it only counts the prompts. Either way it lists the permissions you gave, to revoke them.

key.name: recap-currency
key.summary: The currency of the Recap tab's amounts
key.description: USD, or another currency at the European Central Bank's reference rate of the day: the Recap tab downloads the rates from ecb.europa.eu at most every 6 hours, only while it's open.
